recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, high-contrast close-up portrait emerging from a deep black void. The subject's face is brightly lit, focusing on the eyes and hands held in a prayer-like gesture, with typography framing the top and bottom edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Brightly lit facial features against a total black background
Symmetrical hand placement centered below the nose
Top-heavy display text balanced by wide-tracked bottom text
Intense direct eye contact as the primary focal point
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space surrounding the face
High-key lighting on the skin creating sharp shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up, filling the vertical middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and the bridge of the nose, positioned in the upper-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large top-left text, down to the eyes, following the nose to the hands, and finally to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black void occupying approximately 60% of the canvas.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with very low saturation; almost monochromatic.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a mix of large, stylized numerals and clean, wide-set capitals
Bottom text uses extreme tracking (letter spacing)
Sub-text is enclosed in square brackets
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numeral '2' features a distressed, brush-like texture and elongated tail
Bottom text features a horizontal motion blur or 'scanline' effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact bold display paired with delicate, widely-spaced technical type.

preserve: High contrast between top and bottom font weights

candidateDirections.reason: For the wide, sturdy feel of the display capitals.
For the technical, spaced-out bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, low-saturation portrait of a man with intense eyes and hands held in prayer, emerging from a pure black background. Use harsh top-down lighting to blow out highlights on the forehead and nose.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large bold sans-serif title in the top left. Add two lines of small, extremely wide-tracked monospace text at the bottom center, with the second line in brackets and a slight horizontal motion blur effect.

verificationChecks: Are the hands centered and touching the chin?
Is the bottom text tracking wide enough to span the width of the face?
Is the lighting on the face harsh and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Amount of horizontal blur on bottom text
Scale of the top-left display numeral
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is illegible due to blur
Check that the eyes are the sharpest point of the image
Verify the 'prayer' hand gesture is clearly defined
Confirm the black levels are deep and consistent
recipe.reuseFormula: Chiaroscuro Portrait + Bold Top-Left Display + Wide-Tracked Bottom Technical Type
